tools.name: find_agencies
tools.description: Actual group employment agencies (about 780 in France) in a town or a region, with address and specialties. Candidates can visit or call an agency for advice, registration or follow-up on their applications. To recommend the single most relevant agency for a job, use find_best_agency instead.

region.description: French region name, e.g. "Pays de la Loire".

limit.description: Maximum number of agencies returned. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: find_best_agency
tools.description: Recommend the Actual group agency, office, training centre or school best suited to a person's need, near a place in France. Covers employment agencies (intérim, CDD, CDI), Actual Talent offices (talent acquisition and assessment, mostly white-collar), Envergure centres (vocational training, skills assessment, career transition) and the group's schools (eSUP, Holberton…, often work-study). Ranks them by open offers for the given job, specialty (construction, logistics, medical, white-collar, school domain…) and distance. Returns address, phone, opening status and why each agency was picked. Pass the returned agency code to search_offers (agencyCode) to list that agency's offers.

location.description: French town or postal code, e.g. "Le Mans" or "72000".

job.description: Job or field the person is looking for or hiring for, e.g. "électricien", "cariste", "aide-soignant".

purpose.description: find_job: a candidate looking for work (default). hire: a company looking to recruit. assessment: a company wanting candidates or staff assessed (Actual Talent). training: vocational training, skills assessment or career change (Envergure). school: a degree or work-study programme (group schools). insertion: return-to-work support.

limit.description: Number of agencies to return, 1 to 5. Defaults to 3.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full details of one Actual group job offer: description, required profile, salary, schedule, benefits and recruiting agency. Takes the slug returned by search_offers (also the last segment of the offer URL).

slug.description: Offer slug, from search_offers or the offer URL.

lang.description: Language of the offer text. Defaults to fr.

tools.name: list_offer_facets
tools.description: Exact filter values accepted by search_offers for one dimension (contract type, job family, industry or region), with the number of open offers for each. Optionally scoped by a query and a town.

q.description: Optional free text to scope the counts.

town.description: Optional town or postal code to scope the counts.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search the job offers (temporary work, fixed-term and permanent contracts) published by Actual group in France. Combine a free-text query with a town and filters. Filter values for contractType, family, industry and region must be exact French values: get them from list_offer_facets. Use get_offer with a result's slug for the full offer.

q.description: Free text: job title, skill or keyword, e.g. "cariste", "soudeur TIG", "aide-soignant".

town.description: French town or postal code to search around, e.g. "Rennes" or "35000".

radius.description: Search radius in km around the town. Defaults to 20.

contractType.description: Contract types (exact values from list_offer_facets), e.g. ["Contrat de travail temporaire", "CDI"].

region.description: French regions (exact values from list_offer_facets), e.g. ["Bretagne"].

agencyCode.description: Only offers handled by this agency: the agency code returned by find_best_agency.

pageSize.description: Results per page, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

lang.description: Language of the offer texts and URLs. Defaults to fr.

tools.name: start_application
tools.description: Prepare an application to an Actual group offer on behalf of the candidate you are assisting. Returns a personal link, valid 72 hours, that the candidate must open to attach their CV and give consent to the processing of their data; the application is only sent once they submit that page. Only call this when the candidate has asked to apply and given you their name and email. Never submit the page yourself: give the link to the candidate.

slug.description: Slug of the offer, from search_offers or get_offer.

lang.description: Language of the application page. Defaults to fr.
